column1: # status.governance-vaults.tsv — assessment of the vaults/earn/gauges half of section `governance`.
# SPLIT RULE (agreed with the status.governance-account.tsv lane, endorsed by the wave coordinator):
#   MINE  = /^Skai > (Earn|Yield vaults|Gauge voting)\b/           => 32 screens (Earn 27, Yield vaults 3, Gauge voting 2)
#   THEIRS = the complement                                        => 76 screens (Explorer 26, Learn 18, Governance>Proposals 14, Account 11, Airdrop 4, Rewards 2, Leaderboard 1)
#   32 + 76 = 108, no overlap, no gap. "Governance > Proposals > Staking" is proposal sub-nav, NOT Earn > Stake, so it is theirs.
# ROWS ARE KEYED BY NODE ID, NOT BY FAMILY. apply-status.mjs keys `<section>/<family>`, so no row here matches and this file
# is deliberately INERT with respect to registry.json — it records verdicts, it does not write them. `scaffolding` and
# `blocked-on-backend` are also outside apply-status.mjs's VALID set, which is a second reason nothing here folds back.
# Columns: node <TAB> verdict <TAB> primary implementing file <TAB> route <TAB> reason

column5: 1VH crop of 5243-69438, same design. Earn is routed at App.tsx:1119 and its 5 tabs (opportunities/positions/vaults/faucet/referral) match the frame's sub-nav exactly. HELD PARTIAL for the opportunities surface itself: the frame draws a 10-row TABLE with columns Pool / Fee / APY / TVL / Risk / Volume (1W) / My position / Action; the app renders a category-filter row plus a stack of OpportunityCard components. Two of those columns have no source at all — EarnOpportunity (src/hooks/defi/useEarnData.ts:140-175) has no `fee` and no 1-week volume field, and the pool rows the frame lists (SKAI/USDC aggressive, SKAI/BNB low-risk, SKAI/USDC conservative) are AMM pairs on the venue that is empty. So the table is not a layout change, it is a data gap. The hero copy "Let your crypto work for you!" and its second line are verbatim frame text and are not in the app.

Full-scroll twin of 5220-10996 — identical content plus the Skai wordmark footer (Home/Help/Terms/Privacy) and the price ticker. Same verdict and same reason: tabs and route are right, the opportunities TABLE with Fee and Volume (1W) is not built and two of its columns have no backing field. The footer and ticker are app-wide furniture already shipped elsewhere, not page work.

Real screen, but its ONLY delta against 5243-69438 is a pager: a "Pages" control reading "1 — 10 of 12" under the opportunities table. Earn.tsx has no pagination of any kind (no page state, no slice, no pager control) and the opportunities list is rendered whole. Since the rest of the frame is 5243-69438, the work this frame uniquely asks for is entirely unbuilt.

Real screen — the Earn table filtered to liquidity pools only (4 rows, SKAI/USDC + SKAI/BNB, Fee 0.02%, APY 10-15.22%, TVL $5.6-9.2M, Volume (1W) $1.42-2.34M, My position "--", Action CTA). Cannot be built honestly: there is no LP-pair model anywhere in the earn stack (EarnOpportunity has no pair, no fee tier, no weekly volume), and SKAI's AMM is the empty venue — the live book is the CLOB. Rendering these rows means inventing pools, fees and volumes. Needs a product decision about whether the AMM ships, not frontend work.

The deposited state of 5243-73398: the same 4-row pool table with My position filled in (100M SKAI on three rows) and the Action CTA widened. Blocked for exactly the same reason as its parent, plus it additionally requires a per-user LP position read that does not exist.

Strong match, and the copy was checked verbatim rather than by eye. VaultSelection is mounted at Earn.tsx:1427 inside the Vaults tab and is also lazily routed. The frame's two cards are built (House vault / Trading vault, APY range, TVL, risk meter, and the "Backs" lists — VaultSelection.tsx:74 and :83 carry "Casino games"/"Sportsbook"/"Prediction markets" and "Perps trading (60%)"/"Spot MM (30%)"/"Token launches (10%)" exactly as drawn), and the frame's 5-row comparison is built at VaultSelection.tsx:410-419 with all five labels and both value columns matching the frame word for word (Expected APY, Risk Level, Variance, Revenue Source "House edge"/"Trading P&L", Loss Scenario "Rare large payouts"/"Market drawdowns"). HELD PARTIAL for two unconfirmed elements, not for missing substance: the per-card "1 year" timeframe selector (same blocked class as 11259-40697 / 11260-123547 — no historical vault series exists) and the 5-segment risk bar meter. I read the source; I did not render the page.

Real screen. Top half is built: the positions tab renders PortfolioHeader plus a list of position cards. Bottom half is not: the frame draws a full Activity table (Timestamp / Activity type / Amount / Asset / Source / Destination / Status / Action) with rows for Unbonding, Claim and Staking against "SKAI staking 1" and a 0xAd4...323 destination, plus a "Search activity" input and Recent / All / Staking / Lending / Vault filters. Nothing in Earn.tsx renders an activity history.

Real screen, the empty state of 5248-76804. HALF built: the positions empty state exists (EmptyState "No Active Positions" / "Start earning yield by depositing into one of the opportunities above" / "Browse Opportunities" CTA — the frame says "View opportunities"). The frame's SECOND empty state, for the Activity panel ("No activity history to show" / "You've not made any interaction with your wallet yet, under earn."), has nothing to be empty about because the Activity table itself is not built.

Real screen — the hover state of the positions grid, where the first card reveals an inline "Update position" affordance next to the pair name. Neither the hover affordance nor the surface it opens (11135-77182) exists. This is not a styling gap; there is no update-position flow to reveal.

Real screen — an "Activity details" right-hand drawer over the positions tab, listing Wallet, Status, Source, Destination, Asset, Amount, Activity type, Unbonding period (24 days), Transaction hash and Commission (0.02%). It is opened from the Activity table's "View details" action, and that table is not built (see 5248-76804), so neither the trigger nor the drawer exists.

Real screen — a pool position detail page (SKAI/BNB breadcrumbed under Earn) with a 12-month volume bar chart, My position value $12.12, Volume 24H, Fee, and Withdraw / Add liquidity CTAs. Blocked on the same missing AMM as 5243-73398, and additionally on a historical volume series no contract exposes. No route exists for it either — /pools maps to RiskPools, which is a different product.

Real screen — pool detail for a single opportunity: 12-month volume chart, Total value locked with the SKAI/BNB reserve split, Volume 24H, Fee, an Add liquidity CTA, and an "Other opportunities" table underneath. Same blocker as 11135-77182: no LP pair model, no AMM liquidity, no historical volume. This is the most-drawn missing surface in the section (three frames hang off it).

Real screen, and the single largest unbuilt design in this half — a concentrated-liquidity range editor: candlestick price chart with draggable Min price / Max price handles, fee-tier selector (0.1% / 0.5% / 1% / Full range / Custom), dual-token amount entry (USDT + BNB), slippage, and a Slow / Standard / Fast transaction-speed selector. Grep for "add liquidity" across src returns exactly one file, src/components/predict/LPRewards.tsx, which is prediction-market LP and unrelated. Building this means building a Uniswap-v3-style AMM front end against a venue that has no liquidity.

Real screen — "Review Add liquidity summary" confirmation modal (deposit amount 1.99 SKAI, source instrument SKAI/BNB, currently staked, estimated returns after 3 months, APY, estimated completion date, Confirm order). Child of 10852-361479 and blocked by it; a confirmation step cannot exist before the flow it confirms.

Real screen and substantially built. The frame's lottery panel maps onto FaucetClaimCard (Rolls / Streak / SKAI earned counters and the roll action) plus LotterySection, whose four tabs are exactly the frame's four (overview / tickets / winners / earn, at LotterySection.tsx:700-717). MISSING: the "$1K daily Skai lottery" countdown banner with its Day/Hour/Min/Sec blocks, the All-time selector and the Daily / Weekly toggle, the three-column "Price tiers — Daily price pool" podium (Grand 1,000 SKAI 1-in-10,000 / Major 100 SKAI 1-in-1,000 / Minor 10 SKAI 1-in-100), and the "Pool and treasury stats" six-tile block (SKAI house pool, Available price pool, Fees collected, Prizes distributed, Won by players, Games settled). Those last two are the substance of the frame's Lottery-details tab.

Real screen — a full-width "Search winners" overlay over the faucet, with a search field, All winners / Grand prize / Major prize / Minor prize filter chips, a Today period selector, and a ranked winner list where every row carries a Follow button. Nothing like it exists: RecentWinnersFeed has no search, no prize-tier filter, no period selector and no follow action. Note this frame and 5280-87638 share the title "Skai > Earn > Faucet" but are different screens.

Real screen — the Tickets tab. Built in outline: the tab exists and renders a current-tickets figure. MISSING: the frame's 4-tile "Performance metrics" strip (Current tickets, Prizes won, SKAI won +2.2%, Draws entered) behind an All-time selector, and the "Ticket history" table (Date / Channel / Rolls / Win-Loss / Payout) whose rows carry per-row actions (Roll ticket, Buy again) and channel attribution (Hi-Lo, Platform-buy).

Real screen — the Winners tab. Built in outline: the tab renders RecentWinnersFeed plus a Draw History card. The frame instead draws one flat table (Date / User / Draw / Win-Loss / Payout) with a Recent selector, tier badges (Jackpot / Win / Lose) and zero-payout losing rows. The app's two-card shape and the frame's single table are different presentations of overlapping data, so this is a real but bounded rebuild rather than a data gap.

Real screen — a share-card composer for a lottery outcome: Normal / Gradient theme toggle, an editable caption pre-filled with the win, Referral code and Show outcome amount switches, a live preview card carrying the drawn digits and the referral link, and Copy referral link / Share card on X actions. The repo has SharePortfolioModal and ShareTradeModal, but neither is this surface and neither is reachable from the lottery.

Real screen — the "Earn more" tab, and the closest match in the faucet family. The frame's six "Ways to earn ticket" rows are in the code verbatim: Buy tickets "1 SKAI = 1 entry + bonuses", Vault balance "1 entry per SKAI (daily snapshot)", Faucet claims "1 entry per claim", Hi-Lo gaming "1 entry per 100 SKAI wagered", Streak bonus, Referrals "10 entries per referral" (LotterySection.tsx:97-134). HELD PARTIAL for the right-hand "Buy lottery ticket" panel: the frame states the volume-bonus ladder explicitly (5% at 100+, 10% at 500+, 15% at 1000+, 25% at 5000+) and pairs a token selector with an Amount-to-deposit field and a Max affordance; I confirmed the bonus concept exists in the action list but not that ladder, that selector or that field.

Real screen. The Referral tab is built and routed: 10% commission badge, referral link in a read-only field with a Copy button, and a "View Full Referral Dashboard" CTA into /referral (App.tsx:1126). MISSING vs the frame: the artwork hero with "Invite friends and earn rewards", the promo-code framing ("Share your promo code 'vassimo125'... you'll receive 100 SKAI points for each friend that joins"), and the "Referral main" header button. ★ Worth a product decision, not a fix: the frame and the Earn tab both say 10% commission, while the destination page src/pages/social/Referral.tsx:558 advertises "up to 35% commission" across a tier ladder. Two live surfaces one click apart quote different rates.

Real screen, and the implementation is substantial (1,642 lines) and routed at App.tsx:1532. Confirmed present: the Overview strip (Total TVL / Available Liquidity / Current Exposure / Insurance Fund at TradingVault.tsx:517-520), the depositors and trades-executed counts, the Strategy breakdown block, the five lock plans the frame draws as Flex / Thirty / Ninety / One-eighty / One-year with their bonus, lock and exit rules (TradingVault.tsx:92 onward, carrying chainTier), and the Risk Disclosure section. ★ TWO FRAME DEFECTS THAT MUST NOT BE COPIED: (1) the Strategy breakdown's Main position is literal placeholder copy — "We operate thus: UPDATE THIS CONTENT" — so this frame is a real screen with a scaffolding hole in it, not a spec for that block; (2) the deposit panel reads "Deposit from token: Solana SOL", the amount is denominated in SOL and the CTA says "Deposit SOL", which contradicts the sUSD rail every other vault surface uses. Held partial pending a decision on both.

Real screen, but its ONLY delta against 5280-82910 is a "PnL — Profit and loss chart on this vault" panel: a 12-month line chart with a 1-year timeframe selector and a hover tooltip. That is the same blocker already recorded for 11259-40697 / 11260-123547 and stated in the code itself — src/pages/YieldVaultDetail.tsx:10 says outright that vault contracts do not expose historical values. Everything else on this frame is 5280-82910. (Its quick-amount chips also switch to $100–$1,000 where 5280-82910 uses 0.5–10 SOL, a second sign the two frames disagree about the deposit asset.)

Real screen — pixel-identical to 5280-82910 except for the House labelling (Games / Games played instead of Depositors / Trades executed, and an amber rather than red Risk Disclosure). ★ REACHABILITY PROBLEM, not a build problem: App.tsx:1531 makes /earn/house-vault a redirect to /sports?tab=pool, so the house pool is implemented (SKAIHousePool via BookieDashboard) but lives OUTSIDE the Earn section this frame places it in. Building the frame as drawn would mean a second house-pool surface, so the real question is where it belongs. Carries the same "UPDATE THIS CONTENT" placeholder as its Trading twin, and the frame's own copy leaks: its Additional-details paragraph and its bottom contract label both still say "Trading vault".
Real screen — 5280-86949 plus the same PnL chart panel as 11151-18953, and blocked for the same reason (no historical vault series). Inherits the reachability problem of 5280-86949 on top.

Real screen — a Stake modal: "Stake your SKAI in 'SKAI staking 1'", a Medium-risk tag with Commission 10.00% and Est. APY 8.76%, Currently staked 100M SKAI, an Amount field with 25 / 50 / 75 / Max chips over a wallet balance, an "Unbonding period 24 days" detail row, and a disabled Stake CTA. Nothing like it exists — grep for "unbonding period" across src returns zero hits, and the two "confirm order" matches are the perps order panel, a different product.

Real screen — "Review stake summary" confirmation modal (This stake amount 100.00 SKAI, Source instrument SKAI staking 1, Currently staked, Estimated returns after 24 days +8.76 SKAI, APY 8.76%, Estimated completion date, Confirm order, plus a limit-order execution disclaimer). Child of 5243-74665 and unbuilt with it.

Real screen and closely matched. Routed at App.tsx:1536. Built: the header and subtitle (frame "Deposit sUSDC to the on-chain vaults that back every Skai product", code "Deposit sUSD to the on-chain vaults..." at YieldVaults.tsx:63 — the frame's sUSDC is the retired name), the Aggregate TVL / APY range / Insurance coverage stats (YieldVaults.tsx:99-128), the vault card grid over VaultCard, and InsuranceFundHealth as the third card. MISSING, and the two halves have different causes: the "Feed into liquidity pools" artwork banner is plain unbuilt frontend work, whereas the frame's FOURTH stat "Farmers 139" and the "+100K (14%)" delta under Aggregate TVL are backend-blocked — SKAIYieldVault.sol exposes no depositor-count view and no historical TVL, so both figures would have to be invented. The "1 year" selector at top right is the blocked timeframe control again.

Real screen, 1VH crop of 5515-93883. Built: the Withdraw-from-vault / Deposit-to-vault tab pair, the amount field with Max and the available balance, and most of the right rail — Vault overview covering TVL, APY range, Share price, Shares outstanding, Active deposits, Available liquidity and Pending withdrawals (YieldVaultDetail.tsx:322-336) plus Your position. DepositWithdrawPanel already renders the frame's Estimated shares, Share price and "Lockup: Flexible (no lock)" rows. MISSING: the $100/$200/$300/$500/$1,000 quick-amount chips, the "Potential yield (with 6% APY)" row, the "Holdings analysis" button, and the "Fees $2.16" row. ★ THE FEE ROW IS BLOCKED AND THE KNOWN FINDING UNDERSTATES IT: SKAIYieldVault.sol has no fee logic at all — grepping the contract for "fee" returns only a SafeERC20 import and one comment about receiving house-edge revenue. So it is not only the withdraw frame (11259-44415) that draws an unbacked $2.16; the DEPOSIT tab drawn here carries the identical figure. Rendering either fabricates a money number on a money path.

Real screen — the full-scroll twin of 5515-92313, adding an "Other yield vaults" horizontal carousel with prev/next arrows (SKAI yield vault House card + Insurance fund card) and the page footer. Same verdict and same blocked fee row as its 1VH crop; the carousel is the one extra piece of buildable work, and it is unbuilt.

Real screen — the empty state of gauge voting, and the empty state itself IS built: GaugeWeightsTable.tsx:65-69 renders "No gauges yet" verbatim when the active gauge list is empty, and GaugeVoting is routed at App.tsx:1535 with VotingPowerDisplay and BribeRewardsCard mounted alongside. MISSING vs the frame: the empty panel's second line ("Gauges will appear here once governance registers them") and its "Deposit to vault" CTA, and the right rail's 4-tile "Gauge voting overview" grid (Staked SKAI, Epoch, Voting ends in, Weekly emissions (SKAI)) — the code surfaces epoch and voting power but not as that tile grid.

Real screen — the populated state. Built: the gauges table with per-gauge rows and an epoch badge (GaugeWeightsTable), voting power, and the Bribe rewards claim card. MISSING: the "All gauges" filter select, and the frame's per-row Caps column. ★ THE DONUT IS NOT A SPEC. The frame's left panel is a ring chart legended by Epoch #0 / #1 / #2 / Others with SKAI amounts, but its centre label literally reads "Net worth $289.01 +1.99%" — it is the wallet net-worth donut dropped in as a placeholder, so its geometry says nothing about gauge data. Separately, the per-epoch series it implies is blocked: gauge votes are current-epoch only (useBribeClaims.ts:74-75), the same limit already recorded for 11260-123547.
